rejected_fit.rejection: Robot/visual relative rotations disagree; scene moved or registration/frame pairing is inconsistent

logitech_wrist.drift_cause: Unresolved; camera identity, settings/focus, mounting and frame pairing must be investigated independently. The data do not identify a cause.
logitech_wrist.factory_image_jacobian: Local row-centroid/yaw response at old5_0 reference, not intrinsic or hand-eye calibration. Current factory config marks fresh reference check required.

realsense.scope: RealSense identity/intrinsics eligibility is independent of Logitech lens/mount calibration; one cannot validate the other.

new_baseplate_photo.evidence: Board, plate and tape are visible in an external photograph. User confirms ChArUco board has not moved.
not_established: Logitech optical hand-eye or mounting continuity
new_baseplate_photo.registration_scope: A planar board/image mapping constrains visible layout; it is not wrist-camera optical validation or measured plate contact registration.

missing_evidence: Fresh Logitech lens calibration at fixed actual focus/zoom/resolution with independent views; use existing calibration tools, do not promote rejected archive result.
Stationary/restart board-corner repeatability and independent robot-camera reprojection/hand-eye check with unchanged mounting; diagnose prior8.4px drift.
Target-specific single-brick/plate stud detection and correspondence labels, including meaningful XY/yaw handoff errors and occlusion.
Independent held-brick pose/slip measurements under relevant axial/lateral contact loads; lower-stud observations are insufficient.
Exposure/receipt/state timing calibration and complete-frame detector residual/dropout/confidence/visibility data for projected-feature training.

implementation.normalized_coordinate_convention: Undistorted optical X/Z,Y/Z, not pixels divided by image width/height.
implementation.distortion_models: Explicit five-coefficient Brown-Conrady or explicitzero-distortion. RealSense inverse-Brown identity is not silently reinterpreted.
implementation.projected_feature_model: Geometric projection separate from actor packets. Complete-frame detector residual/dropout/confidence samples share one latency, bind to camera/lens/settings/resolution and named physical evidence; capture-time scene state and independent occlusion mask are required. No profile invented.
implementation.held_brick_policy: Direct pose/slip evidence OR explicitly validated fixed-grasp transform bounds and slip protection, bound to the configured grasp profile and validation evidence IDs. No such physical evidence is currently available. Actual detected slip always stops.
